data.name: Haajid
data.gender_notes: Haajid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘hajj’, meaning ‘pilgrimage’. This name evokes a sense of spiritual journeying and guidance. Haajid may be understood as a guide on the path to God or a pilgrim on the journey to enlightenment. The name Haajid carries the meaning “Guide, Pilgrim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haajid usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, pilgrim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a spiritual significance, representing guidance and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Haajid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Pilgrim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haajid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حاجِد
in_arabic.meaning: حاجِد تعني الشخص الذي يطلب الحاجة أو يسأل الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: حاجِد هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ح-ج-د، والذي يعني الطلب أو السؤال. في اللغة العربية، الحاجِد هو الشخص الذي يطلب حاجة أو يسأل الله تعالى بشيء ما. وقد ورد هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن عبادة الله وطلب الحاجات منه. يعتبر اسم حاجِد من الأسماء التي تعبر عن التواضع وطلب العون من الله

in_urdu.name: حاجد
in_urdu.meaning: حاجد مطلب ہے جو شخص حاجة مانگتا ہے یا اللہ سے پوچھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حاجد ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جڑ ح-ج-د سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مانگنا یا پوچھنا۔ اردو میں، حاجد کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی حاجة کو مانگتا ہے یا اللہ تعالیٰ سے کسی چیز کو پوچھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں عبادت اور اللہ سے حاجات مانگنے کے سیاق میں استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हाजिद

in_hindi.long_meaning: हाजिद एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के मूल जड़ ح-ج-د से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मांगना या पूछना। हिंदी में, हाजिद का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो किसी जरूरत को मांगता है या अल्लाह से कुछ पूछता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में अल्लाह की इबादत और उससे जरूरतें मांगने के संदर्भ में प्रयोग होता है

in_english.name: Haajid
in_english.meaning: Haajid means one who asks or requests something from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Haajid is a name derived from the Arabic root ح-ج-د (ḥ-j-d), which means to ask or request. In Islamic tradition, Haajid refers to one who asks or requests something from Allah. This name is associated with humility and seeking help from Allah. The name Haajid has been used in various Muslim cultures, reflecting its significance in Islamic theology and spirituality

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name of a Berber chieftain named Haajid in his book 'Al-'Ibar', written around 1377 AD. Haajid was a powerful leader of the Banu Temrak tribe in Algeria, and is noted for his military conquests and political alliances.

The Persian poet Saadi of Shiraz (1213-1292 AD) mentions a character named Haajid in his famous book 'Gulistan'. This Haajid is a wise man from the region of Khurasan, who is known for his moral teachings about the value of patience and humility.
